en.short_description: Track your cycle, fertility, pregnancy and menopause. Logs stay on your device.
en.description:
HerJourney is a women's health tracker that follows you through four stages of life, and keeps what you log on your own device.

—— Four journeys ——

CYCLE
Log periods, flow and symptoms. See where you are in your cycle — menstrual, follicular, ovulation or luteal — and what typically comes next.

TRYING TO CONCEIVE
An ovulation calculator estimates your fertile window from your cycle length and last period.

PREGNANCY
A due-date calculator works out how far along you are and when to expect the birth, week by week.

MENOPAUSE
Track the symptoms that matter through perimenopause and after, in the same place as everything else.

—— Log what matters ——

• Periods, flow and cycle length
• Symptoms, mood and notes, day by day
• Weight, water and the metrics you care about
• Charts that show how things move over time

—— Works with Apple Health and Health Connect ——

Grant access once and HerJourney reads steps, heart rate, HRV, sleep, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, active energy and weight, so you do not type in what your phone or watch already knows. It writes menstrual flow, water and weight back, so your other health apps stay in step. Declining leaves every other feature working.

—— Your data stays with you ——

Everything you log is written to a database on your device. There is no advertising SDK and no analytics SDK in the app, and nothing you log is uploaded. Signing in with Apple or Google is entirely optional and is not required to use anything.

—— Not medical advice ——

HerJourney is an education and self-tracking tool. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose anything, and it is not contraception. Estimated fertile windows and due dates are calculations from the dates you enter, not clinical predictions. Talk to a clinician about any decision concerning your health.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing HerJourney.

HerJourney is an offline-first women's health tracker. No account and no sign-in are required — onboarding can be skipped and every feature is reachable immediately. Health data logged in the app is written to a local SQLite database on the device and is never uploaded. Sign in with Apple / Google is optional and authenticates only; this build has no upload path, and the app says so on screen. There is no advertising SDK and no analytics SDK. The in-app guide answers common questions from a built-in offline set of responses when no AI key is configured, which is the case for this build, and the UI labels those answers as offline.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app. On the welcome screens tap 'Skip for now' - no account, sign-in or permission is required to continue.
2. On Home, open the Health tab and choose a journey: Cycle, Conceive, Pregnancy or Menopause. Each opens its own tracking view.
3. In the Cycle view, log a period and a symptom. The entry is written to the on-device database and appears immediately in the list and charts.
4. Open Tools and run the Ovulation Calculator (enter a cycle length and last period date) and the Due Date Calculator. Both compute from the dates entered.
5. Open Profile. The Health section offers Apple Health / Health Connect access - granting it is optional, and declining leaves every other feature working.
6. Also in Profile, the Account section is optional sign-in. It states on screen that logs stay on the device and that cross-device sync is not enabled in this build.
7. Open the Assistant tab and ask a question. Because no AI key is configured in this build, the reply comes from the built-in offline response set and is labelled as offline in the UI.

Privacy:
• Data collected: What you log: periods, flow, symptoms, mood, notes, and the profile details you enter such as age and cycle length. All of it is written to a SQLite database on your device. None of it is uploaded.
• Network: The app is fully usable with no network at all. A network connection is used only if you choose to sign in with Apple or Google, which authenticates you through our authentication provider and nothing more - no health data is sent with it. If a build is configured with an AI key, questions you type into the Assistant, together with the profile context described below, are sent to that AI provider to answer them; the build published to the stores has no AI key configured and answers from a built-in offline set instead.
• Location: Not requested and not used.
• Tracking: None. There is no advertising SDK and no analytics SDK in the app, and it does not read the advertising identifier, so no App Tracking Transparency prompt appears.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
